name: Eagle's Fist

angles.text: The lookout's note highlights the spot as an ideal launch point for a parachute glider, catching the attention of engineers who appreciate aerial recon and mechanical flight.

faq.answer: Eagle's Fist is an encounter centered around a hidden toolbox containing a carefully folded letter at a scenic, misty vantage point overlooking an old barricade. It marks the campsite of a mysterious scout who recently fled.
The author is an unidentified scout or sentry devoted to the Old Kingdoms and an entity or allegiance known as the Eagle and Fist. They maintain a lonely vigil at the dilapidated barricade.
faq.q: Who wrote the letter found in the toolbox?

aliases: what is the eagle and fist
faq.answer: The letter refers to loyalty to 'the Eagle and Fist,' which requires distance to serve best. While the exact organization remains cryptic, it is tied to defending the remnants of the Old Kingdoms.
faq.q: What does 'the Eagle and Fist' refer to?

faq.answer: The scout made a quick departure, leaving behind a campfire newly fed with fresh wood. Their whereabouts remain unknown, though the site was praised as a prime spot to deploy a parachute glider.
The author laments that the barricade has seen better days, comparing its worn condition to the fallen Old Kingdoms of humanity it once defended, yet swears never to abandon guarding it.
The perch features incredible panoramic views and air dampened by water spray, suggesting a high cliff or overlook near a massive waterfall or cascading river.
faq.q: What kind of lookout post is this?

sections.body: Tucked away inside an unassuming toolbox at a scenic vantage point lies a carefully folded letter. The author reflects on the commanding position of the high overlook, remarking on how the location allows one to call the shots or launch a parachute glider across the landscape. Dampened by misty water spray, the lonely post offers an incredible view across historic lands.
sections.title: A Hidden Perch

sections.body: The writer of the note professes a deep, enduring loyalty to 'the Eagle and Fist,' noting that proper service to this cause demands keeping a measured distance. Though acknowledging that the local barricade has fallen into disrepair—much like the Old Kingdoms it once shielded from peril—the steadfast watcher vows never to truly abandon the post.
sections.title: Loyalty to the Old Kingdoms

sections.body: Whoever manned this overlook left in a hurry. Visitors discovering the post will find a campfire that was only recently fed with fresh wood, yet the sentry has vanished without a trace, leaving behind only the tools, the burning embers, and the cryptic letter.
sections.title: A Hasty Departure

summary: Eagle's Fist centers on a cryptic letter discovered inside a toolbox at a misty, high-altitude vantage point. The note reveals a solitary sentry watching over a weathered barricade out of allegiance to the Old Kingdoms and the Eagle and Fist. Though the campfire was recently stoked, the watcher departed in haste.
